structure.opening_style: Context-setting via industry trends or common pain points, followed immediately by the Databricks solution
structure.section_organization: Logical progression: Problem Statement -> High-Level Solution -> Technical Deep Dive/Architecture -> Customer Proof/Benchmark -> Conclusion
structure.code_integration: Inline code snippets and SQL queries used as practical demonstrations of simplicity
structure.conclusion_style: Summary of benefits with direct calls to action (documentation links, 'try it now' prompts)

communication.value_proposition: Combines technical superiority (speed, scale) with business outcomes (ROI, TCO, governance) and ease of use (serverless, managed services).
credibility_markers: Customer quotes (e.g., Corning, Xcel Energy, Tealium)
communication.technical_depth: Deep but accessible; bridges high-level strategic value with low-level implementation details (SQL/Python).
